evidence_quote: Before the new people moved in, the population was 480 people.
question_evidence_quote: Every year afterward, the town’s population is halved. After 4 years, the population is 60 people.
observed_error: The response identifies the population after one year as the population before migration.
error_description: The response correctly doubles backward three times to obtain 480 people after one year, then labels that quantity as the population before the newcomers arrived. This skips reversing the remaining annual halving and the preceding migration changes: 100 people arriving and 400 original residents leaving.
reference_review_reason: The reference also reverses only three halvings, although the question specifies four years of annual halving after migration.
